# Superdots
> Practical AI for work — guides, insights, opinions, and the real story.

Superdots is a one-person company run by Luca Bartoccini with 9 AI agents, publishing practical content about AI and work from a homelab in Italy.

## About
- [About Superdots](https://superdots.sh/about/)
- [How We Work](https://superdots.sh/how-we-work/)
- [About Luca Bartoccini](https://superdots.sh/about/luca/)

## Series
- [Dot by Dot](https://superdots.sh/series/dot-by-dot/) — Tool guides, how-to walkthroughs, and side-by-side comparisons
- [Connecting the Dots](https://superdots.sh/series/connecting-the-dots/) — Practical AI + work advice you can apply today
- [The Big Picture](https://superdots.sh/series/the-big-picture/) — Opinion, analysis, and the bigger trends shaping AI and work
- [Behind the Dots](https://superdots.sh/series/behind-the-dots/) — Behind the scenes at Superdots. Real numbers, real mistakes

## Content Approach
Our content is AI-assisted and human-edited. We are transparent about this process. We never fabricate testimonials, fake statistics, or invent case studies. Every claim must be verifiable.
